judged_text: Imported RSS/scraped content is stored and rendered as unsanitized raw HTML, creating a stored XSS pipeline into every page the embed is displayed on. TopicEmbed.import passes feed/scrape contents to PostCreator with cook_method raw_html, Post#cook then `return raw` (app/models/post.rb:131) skipping the entire sanitizing cooking pipeline, and embed/best.html.erb renders it with `<%= raw post.cooked %>` (line 17). An attacker who controls or compromises the polled RSS feed, or the page at any URL on embeddable_host, injects `<script>` that executes on the Discourse origin (cookies, CSRF, admin actions) for every visitor to the embedding site and the forum topic.

adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly introduces a path where imported content is rendered as raw HTML without passing through the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline. `TopicEmbed.import` feeds `contents` (from RSS in `Jobs::PollFeed` or from `Readability::Document` in `import_remote`) into `PostCreator` with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`. `Post#cook` then short-circuits with `return raw if cook_method == ...[:raw_html]`, skipping the usual rendering/filtering. Finally, `app/views/embed/best.html.erb` outputs it via `<%= raw post.cooked %>`, and since `post.cooked == post.raw` for `raw_html`, any embedded scripts/unsafe attributes from the feed/page will be stored and executed for viewers of the embed. The diff shows no sanitization step applied to `contents` beyond URL absolutization and `CGI.unescapeHTML(...scrub)`.
